_doc: GAME-TRACK THEME (tracker §3.8b). Chosen independently of the hardware skin theme — any skin x any track. `palette` writes the Palette 'tracks' group (so every '@tracks.*' reference in a layout doc re-colours with no wiring); `props` overlays TrackLanesView.HighwaySettings on top of whatever the layout doc authored. See TrackThemes.cs.
name: Starfield
blurb: Deep space. The one that shipped.
